zengwanglun.src: 李白乘舟將欲行，忽聞岸上踏歌聲。
zengwanglun.zh: 李白乘上小船正要出發，忽然聽到岸上傳來踏著節拍唱歌的聲音。
zengwanglun.en: Li Bai had boarded his boat and was about to leave when he suddenly heard singing and stamping feet on the bank.
zengwanglun.simp: 李白乘上小船正要出发，忽然听到岸上传来踏着节拍唱歌的声音。

zengwanglun.src: 桃花潭水深千尺，不及汪倫送我情。
zengwanglun.zh: 桃花潭的水深有千尺，也比不上汪倫送我的情誼深。
zengwanglun.en: Peach Blossom Pool is a thousand feet deep, yet it is not as deep as Wang Lun's feeling in seeing me off.
zengwanglun.simp: 桃花潭的水深有千尺，也比不上汪伦送我的情谊深。

wanglushanpubu.src: 日照香爐生紫煙，遙看瀑布掛前川。
wanglushanpubu.zh: 陽光照在香爐峰上，升起紫色的煙霞，遠遠望去瀑布像一條白練掛在前面的河川上。
wanglushanpubu.en: The sun shines on Incense Burner Peak and a purple haze rises; from afar the waterfall hangs like a white band over the stream ahead.
wanglushanpubu.simp: 阳光照在香炉峰上，升起紫色的烟霞，远远望去瀑布像一条白练挂在前面的河川上。

wanglushanpubu.src: 飛流直下三千尺，疑是銀河落九天。
wanglushanpubu.zh: 水流飛奔直瀉而下，彷彿有三千尺長，讓人懷疑是銀河從九重天上落了下來。
wanglushanpubu.en: The water flies and plunges straight down, as if three thousand feet, and one wonders whether the Milky Way is falling from the ninth heaven.
wanglushanpubu.simp: 水流飞奔直泻而下，仿佛有三千尺长，让人怀疑是银河从九重天上落了下来。

gulangyuexing.src: 小時不識月，呼作白玉盤。
gulangyuexing.zh: 小時候不認識月亮，把它叫做白玉盤。
gulangyuexing.en: As a child I did not know the moon, and called it a white jade plate.
gulangyuexing.simp: 小时候不认识月亮，把它叫做白玉盘。

gulangyuexing.src: 又疑瑤臺鏡，飛在青雲端。
gulangyuexing.zh: 又懷疑它是瑤臺上的明鏡，飛掛在青雲的上端。
gulangyuexing.en: Then I wondered if it was a mirror from the jade terrace, flying at the edge of the blue clouds.
gulangyuexing.simp: 又怀疑它是瑶台上的明镜，飞挂在青云的上端。

gulangyuexing.src: 仙人垂兩足，桂樹作團團。
gulangyuexing.zh: 月中仙人垂著兩隻腳，桂樹長得圓圓團團。
gulangyuexing.en: An immortal lets his two feet hang down, and the cassia tree grows round and thick.
gulangyuexing.simp: 月中仙人垂着两只脚，桂树长得圆圆团团。

gulangyuexing.src: 白兔擣藥成，問言與誰餐。
gulangyuexing.zh: 白兔搗成了藥，請問是給誰吃的呢？
gulangyuexing.en: The white hare has pounded the elixir; I ask, who is it to feed?
gulangyuexing.simp: 白兔捣成了药，请问是给谁吃的呢？

gulangyuexing.src: 蟾蜍蝕圓影，大明夜已殘。
gulangyuexing.zh: 蟾蜍侵蝕了圓圓的月影，明亮的月夜已經殘缺了。
gulangyuexing.en: The toad has eaten away the round shadow, and the great brightness of the night is already ruined.
gulangyuexing.simp: 蟾蜍侵蚀了圆圆的月影，明亮的月夜已经残缺了。

gulangyuexing.src: 羿昔落九烏，天人清且安。
gulangyuexing.zh: 從前后羿射落了九隻太陽鳥，天上人間清朗而安寧。
gulangyuexing.en: Long ago Yi shot down the nine sun-crows, and heaven and earth were clear and peaceful.
gulangyuexing.simp: 从前后羿射落了九只太阳鸟，天上人间清朗而安宁。

gulangyuexing.src: 陰精此淪惑，去去不足觀。
gulangyuexing.zh: 如今陰氣的精華月亮在此沉淪迷亂，還是離去吧，不值得再看。
gulangyuexing.en: Now the essence of yin, the moon, is sunk and bewildered here; away with it, it is not worth looking at.
gulangyuexing.simp: 如今阴气的精华月亮在此沉沦迷乱，还是离去吧，不值得再看。

gulangyuexing.src: 憂來其如何，悽愴摧心肝。
gulangyuexing.zh: 憂愁襲來又能怎麼辦呢？悲傷淒愴得摧毀了心肝。
gulangyuexing.en: When sorrow comes, what can I do? Grief and anguish break my heart and liver.
gulangyuexing.simp: 忧愁袭来又能怎么办呢？悲伤凄怆得摧毁了心肝。

qingpingdiaoqiyi.src: 雲想衣裳花想容，春風拂檻露華濃。
qingpingdiaoqiyi.zh: 看見雲彩就想到她的衣裳，看見花朵就想到她的容顏，春風吹拂欄杆，露珠使花色更濃艷。
qingpingdiaoqiyi.en: Clouds make one think of her robes, flowers of her face; the spring breeze brushes the railing and the dew makes the blossoms richer.
qingpingdiaoqiyi.simp: 看见云彩就想到她的衣裳，看见花朵就想到她的容颜，春风吹拂栏杆，露珠使花色更浓艳。

qingpingdiaoqiyi.src: 若非群玉山頭見，會向瑤臺月下逢。
qingpingdiaoqiyi.zh: 這樣的美人，若不是在群玉山頭見到，就該是在瑤臺的月光下相逢。
qingpingdiaoqiyi.en: Such a beauty must be one seen on the summit of Mount Qunyu, or met under the moon at the Jade Terrace.
qingpingdiaoqiyi.simp: 这样的美人，若不是在群玉山头见到，就该是在瑶台的月光下相逢。

qingpingdiaoqier.src: 一枝紅艷露凝香，雲雨巫山枉斷腸。
qingpingdiaoqier.zh: 一枝紅艷的牡丹，帶露凝聚著香氣，楚王夢中巫山的雲雨，不過是白白地令人斷腸。
qingpingdiaoqier.en: A branch of red peony, dew-laden, its fragrance gathered; the clouds and rain of Wu Mountain only broke hearts in vain.
qingpingdiaoqier.simp: 一枝红艳的牡丹，带露凝聚着香气，楚王梦中巫山的云雨，不过是白白地令人断肠。

qingpingdiaoqier.zh: 請問漢朝的宮中誰能和她相比？
qingpingdiaoqier.en: I ask, who in the Han palace could match her?
qingpingdiaoqier.simp: 请问汉朝的宫中谁能和她相比？

qingpingdiaoqier.zh: 可愛的趙飛燕，也要倚仗新妝才能勉強相似！
qingpingdiaoqier.en: Even the lovely Feiyan could do so only by leaning on a fresh make-up!
qingpingdiaoqier.simp: 可爱的赵飞燕，也要倚仗新妆才能勉强相似！

qingpingdiaoqisan.src: 名花傾國兩相歡，長得君王帶笑看。
qingpingdiaoqisan.zh: 名貴的牡丹與傾國的美人，兩者互相映襯，君王常常含笑地欣賞。
qingpingdiaoqisan.en: The famous flower and the beauty who could topple a kingdom delight each other, and the sovereign gazes on them, smiling.
qingpingdiaoqisan.simp: 名贵的牡丹与倾国的美人，两者互相映衬，君王常常含笑地欣赏。

qingpingdiaoqisan.src: 解釋春風無限恨，沈香亭北倚闌干。
qingpingdiaoqisan.zh: 她消解了君王心中如春風般無盡的煩憂，倚靠在沉香亭北的欄杆上。
qingpingdiaoqisan.en: She dissolves the sovereign's endless troubles like the spring breeze, as she leans on the balustrade north of the Aloeswood Pavilion.
qingpingdiaoqisan.simp: 她消解了君王心中如春风般无尽的烦忧，倚靠在沉香亭北的栏杆上。

wenwangchanglingzuoqianlongbiaoyaoyoucij.src: 楊花落盡子規啼，聞道龍標過五溪。
wenwangchanglingzuoqianlongbiaoyaoyoucij.zh: 楊花落盡，杜鵑聲聲啼叫，聽說你被貶到龍標，要經過五溪。
wenwangchanglingzuoqianlongbiaoyaoyoucij.en: The willow catkins have all fallen and the cuckoo cries; I hear you have been sent down to Longbiao and must pass the Five Streams.
wenwangchanglingzuoqianlongbiaoyaoyoucij.simp: 杨花落尽，杜鹃声声啼叫，听说你被贬到龙标，要经过五溪。

wenwangchanglingzuoqianlongbiaoyaoyoucij.src: 我寄愁心與明月，隨風直到夜郎西。
wenwangchanglingzuoqianlongbiaoyaoyoucij.zh: 我把憂愁的心託付給明月，讓它隨風一直陪你到夜郎以西。
wenwangchanglingzuoqianlongbiaoyaoyoucij.en: I entrust my sorrowful heart to the bright moon, to follow the wind straight to the west of Yelang.
wenwangchanglingzuoqianlongbiaoyaoyoucij.simp: 我把忧愁的心托付给明月，让它随风一直陪你到夜郎以西。

yesushansi.src: 危樓高百尺，手可摘星辰。
yesushansi.zh: 山寺的高樓有百尺高，站在上面伸手就可以摘到星辰。
yesushansi.en: The tower of the mountain temple is a hundred feet high; standing on it one can reach out and pluck the stars.
yesushansi.simp: 山寺的高楼有百尺高，站在上面伸手就可以摘到星辰。

yesushansi.src: 不敢高聲語，恐驚天上人。
yesushansi.zh: 不敢大聲說話，怕驚動了天上的仙人。
yesushansi.en: I dare not speak aloud, for fear of startling the people in heaven.
yesushansi.simp: 不敢大声说话，怕惊动了天上的仙人。

yueye.src: 今夜鄜州月，閨中只獨看。
yueye.zh: 今夜鄜州的月亮，閨房中只有你一個人在獨自看著。
yueye.en: The moon over Fuzhou tonight: in your chamber you must be watching it alone.
yueye.simp: 今夜鄜州的月亮，闺房中只有你一个人在独自看着。

yueye.src: 遙憐小兒女，未解憶長安。
yueye.zh: 我遙遙憐惜年幼的兒女，還不懂得思念在長安的我。
yueye.en: From afar I pity our small children, who do not yet know how to think of me in Chang'an.
yueye.simp: 我遥遥怜惜年幼的儿女，还不懂得思念在长安的我。

yueye.src: 香霧雲鬟濕，清輝玉臂寒。
yueye.zh: 你的雲鬢在香霧中被打濕，玉臂在清冷的月光下感到寒意。
yueye.en: Your cloud-like hair is damp in the fragrant mist; your jade-white arms are cold in the clear moonlight.
yueye.simp: 你的云鬓在香雾中被打湿，玉臂在清冷的月光下感到寒意。

yueye.src: 何時倚虛幌，雙照淚痕乾。
yueye.zh: 什麼時候才能一同倚著薄薄的帷帳，讓月光照著我們，把淚痕曬乾？
yueye.en: When can we lean together by the thin curtain, with the moon shining on us both, and dry our tear-stains?
yueye.simp: 什么时候才能一同倚着薄薄的帷帐，让月光照着我们，把泪痕晒干？

chunyexiyu.src: 好雨知時節，當春乃發生。
chunyexiyu.zh: 好雨知道下雨的時節，正在春天萬物生長之時就降下來。
chunyexiyu.en: A good rain knows its season, and falls just when spring brings things to life.
chunyexiyu.simp: 好雨知道下雨的时节，正在春天万物生长之时就降下来。

chunyexiyu.src: 隨風潛入夜，潤物細無聲。
chunyexiyu.zh: 它隨著風悄悄地在夜裡到來，細細地滋潤萬物，沒有一點聲音。
chunyexiyu.en: It comes in secret with the wind in the night, and moistens all things, softly and without a sound.
chunyexiyu.simp: 它随着风悄悄地在夜里到来，细细地滋润万物，没有一点声音。

chunyexiyu.src: 野徑雲俱黑，江船火獨明。
chunyexiyu.zh: 田野小路和天上的雲都是一片漆黑，只有江上的船上燈火獨自明亮。
chunyexiyu.en: The field paths and the clouds are all black; only the lamp on a boat on the river shines alone.
chunyexiyu.simp: 田野小路和天上的云都是一片漆黑，只有江上的船上灯火独自明亮。

chunyexiyu.src: 曉看紅溼處，花重錦官城。
chunyexiyu.zh: 清晨去看那紅色濕潤的地方，錦官城的花朵一定沉甸甸地帶著雨水。
chunyexiyu.en: At dawn I look at the place where the red is wet: the flowers of Chengdu will hang heavy with rain.
chunyexiyu.simp: 清晨去看那红色湿润的地方，锦官城的花朵一定沉甸甸地带着雨水。

zenghuaqing.src: 錦城絲管日紛紛，半入江風半入雲。
zenghuaqing.zh: 錦官城裡管絃音樂每天紛紛響起，一半飄進江風，一半飄入雲中。
zenghuaqing.en: In the Brocade City, strings and pipes sound every day; half drift into the river wind and half into the clouds.
zenghuaqing.simp: 锦官城里管弦音乐每天纷纷响起，一半飘进江风，一半飘入云中。

zenghuaqing.src: 此曲秪應天上有，人間能得幾回聞。
zenghuaqing.zh: 這樣的曲子只應天上才有，人間能聽到幾回呢？
zenghuaqing.en: Such music should exist only in heaven; how many times can one hear it among men?
zenghuaqing.simp: 这样的曲子只应天上才有，人间能听到几回呢？

shizhisaishang.src: 單車欲問邊，屬國過居延。
shizhisaishang.zh: 我乘著單車要去慰問邊關，經過屬國，來到居延。
shizhisaishang.en: With a single carriage I am going to visit the frontier troops, passing the dependent state and reaching Juyan.
shizhisaishang.simp: 我乘着单车要去慰问边关，经过属国，来到居延。

shizhisaishang.src: 征蓬出漢塞，歸雁入胡天。
shizhisaishang.zh: 像飛蓬一樣的我走出漢朝的邊塞，像歸雁一樣進入胡人的天空。
shizhisaishang.en: Like a drifting tumbleweed I leave the Han frontier; like a returning wild goose I enter the sky of the nomads.
shizhisaishang.simp: 像飞蓬一样的我走出汉朝的边塞，像归雁一样进入胡人的天空。

shizhisaishang.src: 大漠孤煙直，長河落日圓。
shizhisaishang.zh: 大沙漠中一縷孤煙筆直上升，長長的黃河上落日渾圓。
shizhisaishang.en: In the great desert a single column of smoke rises straight; over the long river the setting sun is round.
shizhisaishang.simp: 大沙漠中一缕孤烟笔直上升，长长的黄河上落日浑圆。

shizhisaishang.src: 蕭關逢候騎，都護在燕然。
shizhisaishang.zh: 在蕭關遇到偵察的騎兵，說都護正在遙遠的燕然前線。
shizhisaishang.en: At Xiaoguan I meet a scouting horseman, who says the Protector-General is at Yanran, far ahead.
shizhisaishang.simp: 在萧关遇到侦察的骑兵，说都护正在遥远的燕然前线。

guanlie.src: 風勁角弓鳴，將軍獵渭城。
guanlie.zh: 風勢強勁，角弓發出鳴響，將軍在渭城一帶打獵。
guanlie.en: The wind is fierce and the horn bows twang; the general is hunting around Weicheng.
guanlie.simp: 风势强劲，角弓发出鸣响，将军在渭城一带打猎。

guanlie.src: 草枯鷹眼疾，雪盡馬蹄輕。
guanlie.zh: 草已枯黃，鷹的眼睛格外敏銳，雪已融盡，馬蹄格外輕快。
guanlie.en: The grass is withered and the hawk's eye is keen; the snow has melted and the horse's hooves are light.
guanlie.simp: 草已枯黄，鹰的眼睛格外敏锐，雪已融尽，马蹄格外轻快。

guanlie.src: 忽過新豐市，還歸細柳營。
guanlie.zh: 忽然間經過了新豐市，又回到了細柳營。
guanlie.en: Suddenly they pass through Xinfeng market, and soon return to the camp at Xiliu.
guanlie.simp: 忽然间经过了新丰市，又回到了细柳营。

guanlie.src: 迴看射鵰處，千里暮雲平。
guanlie.zh: 回頭望向射鵰的地方，千里暮雲平鋪。
guanlie.en: Looking back to where he shot the eagle, one sees evening clouds stretch level for a thousand li.
guanlie.simp: 回头望向射雕的地方，千里暮云平铺。

niaomingjian.src: 人閑桂花落，夜靜春山空。
niaomingjian.zh: 人閒靜下來，只聽到桂花飄落，夜晚寂靜，春天的山顯得空曠。
niaomingjian.en: With people at rest, only the cassia blossoms fall; the night is still and the spring hills are empty.
niaomingjian.simp: 人闲静下来，只听到桂花飘落，夜晚寂静，春天的山显得空旷。

niaomingjian.src: 月出驚山鳥，時鳴春澗中。
niaomingjian.zh: 月亮升起，驚動了山中的鳥，不時在春天的山澗裡啼叫。
niaomingjian.en: The moon rises and startles the mountain birds, which now and then call in the spring stream.
niaomingjian.simp: 月亮升起，惊动了山中的鸟，不时在春天的山涧里啼叫。

zhongnanbieye.src: 中歲頗好道，晚家南山陲。
zhongnanbieye.zh: 中年以後我很喜愛佛道，晚年在終南山邊安家。
zhongnanbieye.en: In middle age I became fond of the Buddhist Way, and in later years made my home at the foot of the Zhongnan hills.
zhongnanbieye.simp: 中年以后我很喜爱佛道，晚年在终南山边安家。

zhongnanbieye.src: 興來每獨往，勝事空自知。
zhongnanbieye.zh: 興致來時常常獨自前去，美好的事只有自己知道。
zhongnanbieye.en: When the mood comes I often go alone; the delights are known to me only.
zhongnanbieye.simp: 兴致来时常常独自前去，美好的事只有自己知道。

zhongnanbieye.src: 行到水窮處，坐看雲起時。
zhongnanbieye.zh: 走到溪水的盡頭，就坐下來看雲霧升起。
zhongnanbieye.en: I walk to where the stream ends, and sit and watch the clouds rise.
zhongnanbieye.simp: 走到溪水的尽头，就坐下来看云雾升起。

zhongnanbieye.src: 偶然值林叟，談笑無還期。
zhongnanbieye.zh: 偶然遇到林中的老人，談笑起來忘了回家的時間。
zhongnanbieye.en: By chance I meet an old man of the woods, and we talk and laugh with no thought of when to go back.
zhongnanbieye.simp: 偶然遇到林中的老人，谈笑起来忘了回家的时间。

liangzhouci.src: 黃河遠上白雲間，一片孤城萬仞山。
liangzhouci.zh: 黃河遠遠向上流去，彷彿流入白雲之間，一座孤零零的城池倚在萬仞高山之下。
liangzhouci.en: The Yellow River runs far up as if into the white clouds, and a lone fortress stands beneath mountains ten thousand fathoms high.
liangzhouci.simp: 黄河远远向上流去，仿佛流入白云之间，一座孤零零的城池倚在万仞高山之下。

liangzhouci.src: 羌笛何須怨楊柳，春風不度玉門關。
liangzhouci.zh: 羌笛何必吹〈折楊柳〉來怨恨離別，春風本來就吹不到玉門關外。
liangzhouci.en: Why should the Qiang flute sound the sad 'Breaking the Willow' tune? The spring breeze never passes Jade Gate Pass.
liangzhouci.simp: 羌笛何必吹〈折杨柳〉来怨恨离别，春风本来就吹不到玉门关外。

yongliu.src: 碧玉妝成一樹高，萬條垂下綠絲縧。
yongliu.zh: 高高的一棵柳樹像碧玉妝成，千萬條枝條垂下，像綠色的絲帶。
yongliu.en: A tall willow looks made of green jade, and its ten thousand branches hang down like green silk ribbons.
yongliu.simp: 高高的一棵柳树像碧玉妆成，千万条枝条垂下，像绿色的丝带。

yongliu.src: 不知細葉誰裁出，二月春風似剪刀。
yongliu.zh: 不知道這細細的葉子是誰裁剪出來的，二月的春風就像一把剪刀。
yongliu.en: I do not know who cut out these slender leaves; the spring wind of the second month is like a pair of scissors.
yongliu.simp: 不知道这细细的叶子是谁裁剪出来的，二月的春风就像一把剪刀。

dengkehou.src: 昔日齷齪不足誇，今朝放蕩思無涯。
dengkehou.zh: 往日的窘迫困頓不值得誇耀，今天暢快放縱，思緒無邊無際。
dengkehou.en: The cramped misery of the past is nothing to boast of; today I am free and carefree, with thoughts boundless.
dengkehou.simp: 往日的窘迫困顿不值得夸耀，今天畅快放纵，思绪无边无际。

dengkehou.src: 春風得意馬蹄疾，一日看盡長安花。
dengkehou.zh: 春風得意，馬蹄奔得飛快，一天之內就看遍了長安的花。
dengkehou.en: In the spring breeze, pleased with myself, my horse's hooves fly; in one day I see all the flowers of Chang'an.
dengkehou.simp: 春风得意，马蹄奔得飞快，一天之内就看遍了长安的花。

minnong.src: 鋤禾日當午，汗滴禾下土。
minnong.zh: 農夫在正午的烈日下鋤地，汗水滴落在禾苗下的泥土裡。
minnong.en: Hoeing the millet under the midday sun, sweat drips onto the soil beneath the plants.
minnong.simp: 农夫在正午的烈日下锄地，汗水滴落在禾苗下的泥土里。

minnong.src: 誰知盤中飧，粒粒皆辛苦。
minnong.zh: 有誰知道碗裡的飯食，每一粒都是辛苦得來的？
minnong.en: Who knows that of the meal in the bowl, every grain comes from hard toil?
minnong.simp: 有谁知道碗里的饭食，每一粒都是辛苦得来的？

fudeguyuancaosongbie.src: 離離原上草，一歲一枯榮。
fudeguyuancaosongbie.zh: 原野上的草長得茂盛繁密，每年都經歷一次枯萎和繁盛。
fudeguyuancaosongbie.en: The grass on the plain grows thick and lush, withering and flourishing once every year.
fudeguyuancaosongbie.simp: 原野上的草长得茂盛繁密，每年都经历一次枯萎和繁盛。

fudeguyuancaosongbie.src: 野火燒不盡，春風吹又生。
fudeguyuancaosongbie.zh: 野火燒不盡它，春風一吹又生長起來。
fudeguyuancaosongbie.en: Wild fire cannot burn it all away; when the spring wind blows it grows again.
fudeguyuancaosongbie.simp: 野火烧不尽它，春风一吹又生长起来。

fudeguyuancaosongbie.src: 遠芳侵古道，晴翠接荒城。
fudeguyuancaosongbie.zh: 遠處的芳草侵蔓到古老的道路上，晴天下的翠綠連接著荒涼的城池。
fudeguyuancaosongbie.en: Fragrant grass in the distance creeps over the old road, and its green under the bright sky joins the deserted city.
fudeguyuancaosongbie.simp: 远处的芳草侵蔓到古老的道路上，晴天下的翠绿连接着荒凉的城池。

fudeguyuancaosongbie.src: 又送王孫去，萋萋滿別情。
fudeguyuancaosongbie.zh: 又一次送走友人遠去，茂盛的青草裡滿含離別的情意。
fudeguyuancaosongbie.en: Once more I see a friend off; the lush grass is full of the feeling of parting.
fudeguyuancaosongbie.simp: 又一次送走友人远去，茂盛的青草里满含离别的情意。

dalinsitaohua.src: 人間四月芳菲盡，山寺桃花始盛開。
dalinsitaohua.zh: 人間四月，百花已經凋謝殆盡，山上寺廟的桃花才剛剛盛開。
dalinsitaohua.en: In the human world, the fourth month has ended the fragrant blooms, but the peach blossoms at the mountain temple are just now at their fullest.
dalinsitaohua.simp: 人间四月，百花已经凋谢殆尽，山上寺庙的桃花才刚刚盛开。

dalinsitaohua.src: 長恨春歸無覓處，不知轉入此中來。
dalinsitaohua.zh: 我常恨春天歸去後無處可尋，不知它竟轉到這山中來了。
dalinsitaohua.en: I always regret that spring has gone and cannot be found, not knowing that it had turned and come up here.
dalinsitaohua.simp: 我常恨春天归去后无处可寻，不知它竟转到这山中来了。

qiantanghuchunxing.src: 孤山寺北賈亭西，水面初平雲腳低。
qiantanghuchunxing.zh: 孤山寺的北面，賈公亭的西面，湖水剛與岸齊平，低低的雲腳垂在水面。
qiantanghuchunxing.en: North of Gushan Temple, west of Jia Pavilion, the lake has just risen level with its banks, and the cloud bases hang low on the water.
qiantanghuchunxing.simp: 孤山寺的北面，贾公亭的西面，湖水刚与岸齐平，低低的云脚垂在水面。

qiantanghuchunxing.src: 幾處早鶯爭暖樹，誰家新燕啄春泥。
qiantanghuchunxing.zh: 幾處早來的黃鶯爭著飛上向陽的暖樹，誰家新來的燕子在啄春天的泥。
qiantanghuchunxing.en: Here and there early orioles vie for the sunny warm trees; whose new-come swallows are pecking spring mud?
qiantanghuchunxing.simp: 几处早来的黄莺争着飞上向阳的暖树，谁家新来的燕子在啄春天的泥。

qiantanghuchunxing.src: 亂花漸欲迷人眼，淺草才能沒馬蹄。
qiantanghuchunxing.zh: 繁亂的野花漸漸要迷住人的眼睛，淺淺的草剛好沒過馬蹄。
qiantanghuchunxing.en: Profuse wild flowers are almost dazzling the eyes, and the short grass just covers the horses' hooves.
qiantanghuchunxing.simp: 繁乱的野花渐渐要迷住人的眼睛，浅浅的草刚好没过马蹄。

qiantanghuchunxing.src: 最愛湖東行不足，綠楊陰裏白沙堤。
qiantanghuchunxing.zh: 我最喜愛湖東這一帶，走不夠，綠楊樹陰裡有白沙堤。
qiantanghuchunxing.en: What I love best is the east of the lake, which I can never walk enough: the white sand causeway in the shade of green willows.
qiantanghuchunxing.simp: 我最喜爱湖东这一带，走不够，绿杨树阴里有白沙堤。

chishang.src: 褭褭涼風動，淒淒寒露零。
chishang.zh: 微微的涼風吹動，淒清的寒露滴落。
chishang.en: A faint cool wind stirs, and the cold dew falls in chill.
chishang.simp: 微微的凉风吹动，凄清的寒露滴落。

chishang.src: 蘭衰花始白，荷破葉猶青。
chishang.zh: 蘭草已衰，花才剛剛變白；荷葉破損，葉子還是青色。
chishang.en: The orchids are fading and their flowers are turning white; the lotus leaves are torn, yet still green.
chishang.simp: 兰草已衰，花才刚刚变白；荷叶破损，叶子还是青色。

chishang.src: 獨立棲沙鶴，雙飛照水螢。
chishang.zh: 沙洲上獨自站立著棲息的白鶴，水面上成雙飛舞的螢火蟲映照著水光。
chishang.en: A crane stands alone to roost on the sandbar, and fireflies fly in pairs, shining over the water.
chishang.simp: 沙洲上独自站立着栖息的白鹤，水面上成双飞舞的萤火虫映照着水光。

chishang.src: 若為寥落境，仍值酒初醒。
chishang.zh: 怎能忍受這樣寂寥的景象，偏偏又是酒剛剛醒來的時候。
chishang.en: How can I bear such a lonely scene, just as I have sobered up from the wine?
chishang.simp: 怎能忍受这样寂寥的景象，偏偏又是酒刚刚醒来的时候。

yijiangnan.zh: 江南好，那裡的風景我以前很熟悉。
yijiangnan.en: Jiangnan is lovely; I once knew its scenery well.
yijiangnan.simp: 江南好，那里的风景我以前很熟悉。

yijiangnan.src: 日出江花紅勝火，春來江水綠如藍。
yijiangnan.zh: 太陽出來，江邊的花紅得勝過火焰，春天來了，江水綠得像藍草。
yijiangnan.en: When the sun rises, the flowers by the river are redder than fire; when spring comes, the river is as green as indigo.
yijiangnan.simp: 太阳出来，江边的花红得胜过火焰，春天来了，江水绿得像蓝草。

yijiangnan.src: 能不憶江南。江南憶，最憶是杭州。
yijiangnan.zh: 怎能不懷念江南？說起對江南的回憶，最難忘的是杭州。
yijiangnan.en: How can I not think of Jiangnan? Of Jiangnan, what I recall most is Hangzhou.
yijiangnan.simp: 怎能不怀念江南？说起对江南的回忆，最难忘的是杭州。

yijiangnan.src: 山寺月中尋桂子，郡亭枕上看潮頭。
yijiangnan.zh: 在山中寺院的月光下尋找桂子，在郡亭的枕上觀看潮頭。
yijiangnan.en: In the moonlight at the mountain temple I looked for cassia seeds; on the pillow in the prefectural pavilion I watched the tidal bore.
yijiangnan.simp: 在山中寺院的月光下寻找桂子，在郡亭的枕上观看潮头。

yijiangnan.src: 何日更重遊。江南憶，其次憶吳宮。
yijiangnan.zh: 什麼時候能再重遊？江南令人懷念的，其次是吳宮。
yijiangnan.en: When can I visit again? Of Jiangnan, what I recall next is the Wu palace.
yijiangnan.simp: 什么时候能再重游？江南令人怀念的，其次是吴宫。

yijiangnan.src: 吳酒一杯春竹葉，吳娃雙舞醉芙蓉。早晚復相逢。
yijiangnan.zh: 喝一杯春天的吳地竹葉酒，看吳地的少女雙雙起舞，醉人如芙蓉，不知早晚能否再相逢。
yijiangnan.en: A cup of Wu wine, spring-bamboo-leaf, and two Wu girls dancing, drunken as lotuses. Sooner or later, will we meet again?
yijiangnan.simp: 喝一杯春天的吴地竹叶酒，看吴地的少女双双起舞，醉人如芙蓉，不知早晚能否再相逢。

xiaoerchuidiao.src: 蓬頭稚子學垂綸，側坐莓苔草映身。
xiaoerchuidiao.zh: 一個蓬頭亂髮的小孩學著垂釣，側身坐著，青苔和野草掩映著他的身影。
xiaoerchuidiao.en: A shaggy-haired child is learning to fish, sitting sideways, half hidden by moss and grass.
xiaoerchuidiao.simp: 一个蓬头乱发的小孩学着垂钓，侧身坐着，青苔和野草掩映着他的身影。

xiaoerchuidiao.src: 路人借問遙招手，怕得魚驚不應人。
xiaoerchuidiao.zh: 路人遠遠招手問路，他怕嚇跑了魚，不敢回答。
xiaoerchuidiao.en: A passer-by waves from afar and asks the way, but the boy, afraid of scaring the fish, does not answer.
xiaoerchuidiao.simp: 路人远远招手问路，他怕吓跑了鱼，不敢回答。

xinggong.src: 寥落古行宮，宮花寂寞紅。
xinggong.zh: 冷落寂寥的古老行宮，宮中的花朵寂寞地開著紅色。
xinggong.en: A lonely old travelling palace; its flowers bloom red in the stillness.
xinggong.simp: 冷落寂寥的古老行宫，宫中的花朵寂寞地开着红色。

xinggong.src: 白頭宮女在，閑坐說玄宗。
xinggong.zh: 頭髮已白的宮女還在，閒坐著談論玄宗皇帝。
xinggong.en: White-haired palace women are still here, sitting idly and talking about Emperor Xuanzong.
xinggong.simp: 头发已白的宫女还在，闲坐着谈论玄宗皇帝。

shanxing.src: 遠上寒山石徑斜，白雲生處有人家。
shanxing.zh: 向遠處登上寒冷的山，石頭小路蜿蜒傾斜，白雲升起的地方有幾戶人家。
shanxing.en: Far up the cold mountain a stone path winds slanting; where the white clouds rise there are a few homes.
shanxing.simp: 向远处登上寒冷的山，石头小路蜿蜒倾斜，白云升起的地方有几户人家。

shanxing.src: 停車坐愛楓林晚，霜葉紅於二月花。
shanxing.zh: 停下車來，只因為喜愛傍晚的楓林，經霜的紅葉比二月的花還要紅。
shanxing.en: I stop the carriage, simply because I love the maple woods at dusk; the frosted leaves are redder than flowers of the second month.
shanxing.simp: 停下车来，只因为喜爱傍晚的枫林，经霜的红叶比二月的花还要红。

shangshanzaoxing.src: 晨起動征鐸，客行悲故鄉。
shangshanzaoxing.zh: 清晨起來，旅途的車馬鈴鐺已響動，出門在外的人傷感地想念故鄉。
shangshanzaoxing.en: I rise at dawn and the carriage bells jingle; the traveller grieves for his old home.
shangshanzaoxing.simp: 清晨起来，旅途的车马铃铛已响动，出门在外的人伤感地想念故乡。

shangshanzaoxing.src: 雞聲茅店月，人跡板橋霜。
shangshanzaoxing.zh: 雞鳴聲中，茅草旅店上懸著殘月，木板橋上的霜上有人的足跡。
shangshanzaoxing.en: Cocks crow; the moon hangs over the thatched inn; on the frost of the plank bridge are footprints.
shangshanzaoxing.simp: 鸡鸣声中，茅草旅店上悬着残月，木板桥上的霜上有人的足迹。

shangshanzaoxing.src: 槲葉落山路，枳花明驛牆。
shangshanzaoxing.zh: 槲樹的葉子落在山路上，枳樹的花開得明亮，照亮了驛站的牆。
shangshanzaoxing.en: Oak leaves fall on the mountain road, and the bright trifoliate orange blossoms light the post-station wall.
shangshanzaoxing.simp: 槲树的叶子落在山路上，枳树的花开得明亮，照亮了驿站的墙。

shangshanzaoxing.src: 因思杜陵夢，鳧雁滿回塘。
shangshanzaoxing.zh: 於是想起杜陵的夢，夢中野鴨和大雁佈滿了曲折的池塘。
shangshanzaoxing.en: And so I recall a dream of Duling, with ducks and wild geese filling the winding pond.
shangshanzaoxing.simp: 于是想起杜陵的梦，梦中野鸭和大雁布满了曲折的池塘。

yanmentaishouxing.src: 黑雲壓城城欲摧，甲光向日金鱗開。
yanmentaishouxing.zh: 黑雲壓向城頭，城牆好像要被摧垮，鎧甲在陽光下閃耀，像金色的魚鱗般展開。
yanmentaishouxing.en: Black clouds press on the city and it seems the walls will crumble; the armour glitters in the sun, spread out like golden scales.
yanmentaishouxing.simp: 黑云压向城头，城墙好像要被摧垮，铠甲在阳光下闪耀，像金色的鱼鳞般展开。

yanmentaishouxing.src: 角聲滿天秋色裏，塞上燕脂凝夜紫。
yanmentaishouxing.zh: 號角聲響徹秋天的天空，塞上的胭脂般的血跡在夜色中凝成紫色。
yanmentaishouxing.en: Horns sound across the autumn sky; on the frontier the rouge-like blood congeals purple in the night.
yanmentaishouxing.simp: 号角声响彻秋天的天空，塞上的胭脂般的血迹在夜色中凝成紫色。

yanmentaishouxing.src: 半卷紅旗臨易水，霜重鼓寒聲不起。
yanmentaishouxing.zh: 半卷著紅旗開到易水邊，霜很重，戰鼓冰冷，敲不出聲音。
yanmentaishouxing.en: Red banners half furled, they reach the Yi River; the frost is heavy and the drums so cold that they will not sound.
yanmentaishouxing.simp: 半卷着红旗开到易水边，霜很重，战鼓冰冷，敲不出声音。

yanmentaishouxing.src: 報君黃金臺上意，提攜玉龍為君死！
yanmentaishouxing.zh: 為了報答君王在黃金臺上的賞識之意，我提著寶劍，為君王戰死！
yanmentaishouxing.en: To repay the lord's regard shown on the Golden Terrace, I take up my jade-dragon sword and will die for him!
yanmentaishouxing.simp: 为了报答君王在黄金台上的赏识之意，我提着宝剑，为君王战死！

fengxuesufurongshanzhuren.src: 日暮蒼山遠，天寒白屋貧。
fengxuesufurongshanzhuren.zh: 傍晚時蒼茫的山顯得遙遠，天氣寒冷，白茅草屋顯得貧寒。
fengxuesufurongshanzhuren.en: At dusk the grey mountains seem far; the sky is cold and the thatched hut is poor.
fengxuesufurongshanzhuren.simp: 傍晚时苍茫的山显得遥远，天气寒冷，白茅草屋显得贫寒。

fengxuesufurongshanzhuren.src: 柴門聞犬吠，風雪夜歸人。
fengxuesufurongshanzhuren.zh: 柴門外聽到狗叫，是風雪夜裡有人歸來。
fengxuesufurongshanzhuren.en: At the brushwood gate dogs bark: someone is coming home on a night of wind and snow.
fengxuesufurongshanzhuren.simp: 柴门外听到狗叫，是风雪夜里有人归来。

yuweng.src: 漁翁夜傍西巖宿，曉汲清湘燃楚竹。
yuweng.zh: 漁翁夜裡靠著西邊的山岩住宿，清晨汲取清澈的湘江水，燒著楚地的竹子。
yuweng.en: The old fisherman spends the night by the western cliff; at dawn he draws clear Xiang water and burns Chu bamboo.
yuweng.simp: 渔翁夜里靠着西边的山岩住宿，清晨汲取清澈的湘江水，烧着楚地的竹子。

yuweng.src: 煙銷日出不見人，欸乃一聲山水綠。
yuweng.zh: 煙霧散去，太陽出來，卻不見人影，只聽見一聲搖櫓聲，山水一片翠綠。
yuweng.en: The mist clears, the sun comes up and he is nowhere to be seen; one creak of the oar, and the hills and waters are green.
yuweng.simp: 烟雾散去，太阳出来，却不见人影，只听见一声摇橹声，山水一片翠绿。

yuweng.src: 迴看天際下中流，巖上無心雲相逐。
yuweng.zh: 回頭望向天邊，船已順流而下到了江心，山岩上無心的白雲互相追逐。
yuweng.en: Looking back towards the horizon, he has drifted to midstream, and above the cliff the unthinking clouds chase one another.
yuweng.simp: 回头望向天边，船已顺流而下到了江心，山岩上无心的白云互相追逐。

jiangshangyuzhe.src: 江上往來人，但愛鱸魚美。
jiangshangyuzhe.zh: 江上來來往往的人，只喜愛鱸魚的味道鮮美。
jiangshangyuzhe.en: The people who come and go on the river only love the delicious taste of perch.
jiangshangyuzhe.simp: 江上来来往往的人，只喜爱鲈鱼的味道鲜美。

jiangshangyuzhe.src: 君看一葉舟，出沒風波裏。
jiangshangyuzhe.zh: 你看那一葉小船，在風浪裡時隱時現。
jiangshangyuzhe.en: Look at that little leaf of a boat, appearing and vanishing in the wind and waves.
jiangshangyuzhe.simp: 你看那一叶小船，在风浪里时隐时现。

yonge.zh: 鵝，鵝，鵝，彎著脖子向天歌唱。
yonge.en: Goose, goose, goose, with curved necks they sing to the sky.
yonge.simp: 鹅，鹅，鹅，弯着脖子向天歌唱。

yonge.src: 白毛浮綠水，紅掌撥清波。
yonge.zh: 白色的羽毛浮在綠水上，紅色的腳掌撥動著清澈的水波。
yonge.en: White feathers float on the green water, and red webbed feet paddle the clear ripples.
yonge.simp: 白色的羽毛浮在绿水上，红色的脚掌拨动着清澈的水波。

tixilinbi.src: 橫看成嶺側成峰，遠近高低各不同。
tixilinbi.zh: 從正面看是連綿的山嶺，從側面看是獨立的山峰，遠近高低各不相同。
tixilinbi.en: Seen from the front it is a ridge, from the side a peak; far or near, high or low, it is never the same.
tixilinbi.simp: 从正面看是连绵的山岭，从侧面看是独立的山峰，远近高低各不相同。

tixilinbi.src: 不識廬山真面目，祇緣身在此山中。
tixilinbi.zh: 看不清廬山真正的面貌，只因為自己身在這座山中。
tixilinbi.en: I cannot see the true face of Mount Lu, simply because I am within the mountain itself.
tixilinbi.simp: 看不清庐山真正的面貌，只因为自己身在这座山中。

yinhushangchuqinghouyu.src: 水光瀲灧晴方好，山色空濛雨亦奇。
yinhushangchuqinghouyu.zh: 水光閃動，晴天時正好；山色迷濛，下雨時也很奇妙。
yinhushangchuqinghouyu.en: The water sparkles, best in fine weather; the hills are hazy, wonderful in rain too.
yinhushangchuqinghouyu.simp: 水光闪动，晴天时正好；山色迷蒙，下雨时也很奇妙。

yinhushangchuqinghouyu.src: 欲把西湖比西子，淡粧濃抹總相宜。
yinhushangchuqinghouyu.zh: 想把西湖比作西施，淡淡的妝飾和濃濃的打扮都很適宜。
yinhushangchuqinghouyu.en: If I compare West Lake to Xishi, whether lightly or heavily made up, she is always lovely.
yinhushangchuqinghouyu.simp: 想把西湖比作西施，淡淡的妆饰和浓浓的打扮都很适宜。

huichongchunjiangwanjing.src: 竹外桃花三兩枝，春江水暖鴨先知。
huichongchunjiangwanjing.zh: 竹林外有三兩枝桃花，春天江水變暖，鴨子最先知道。
huichongchunjiangwanjing.en: Beyond the bamboo a few branches of peach blossom; the spring river warms and the ducks are first to know.
huichongchunjiangwanjing.simp: 竹林外有三两枝桃花，春天江水变暖，鸭子最先知道。

huichongchunjiangwanjing.src: 蔞蒿滿地蘆芽短，正是河豚欲上時。
huichongchunjiangwanjing.zh: 蔞蒿鋪滿地面，蘆葦的新芽還短，正是河豚要逆流而上的時候。
huichongchunjiangwanjing.en: Artemisia covers the ground and the reed shoots are still short; it is just the time that puffer fish go upstream.
huichongchunjiangwanjing.simp: 蒌蒿铺满地面，芦苇的新芽还短，正是河豚要逆流而上的时候。
